title: 两个储能元件都有初值的零输入响应
statement: 图示电路中 V_s = 10 V，R_1 = 4 Ω，C = 40 mF，L = 1 H，R_2 = 6 Ω。开关 S 闭合已久，t = 0 时断开。i_L（从上向下流过 L、R_2）与 v_C（上“+”下“−”）的参考方向如图。
t > 0 时 C 与 L、R_2 组成一个回路，两个储能元件都有初值。运算电路中，电感 = sL 串电压源 L·i_L(0₋)，沿 i_L 方向推动电流；电容 = 1/(sC) 串电压源 v_C(0₋)/s，“+”在上。求 I_L(s) 的极点（也就是 t > 0 电路的固有频率），以及它在 p_1 = −α + jω_d 处的系数 K_1。再求 t = 0.2 s 时的 i_L 和 v_C。

questions.ask: t > 0 回路（C → L → R_2 → C）的运算形式 KVL 是：
choiceExplain: 电容电压源的符号错了：i_L 从电容上端（“+”）流出，电容正在放电，它的附加电源推动 i_L。
电感附加电源的符号错了：它要维持原来的电流 i_L(0₋)，方向与 i_L 一致。
这是并联形式里的电流源的值，不能直接写进串联回路的 KVL。
questions.explain: 沿 i_L 绕行。电感的附加电压源 L·i_L(0₋) 沿 i_L 方向推动电流，取“+”。电容的附加电压源 v_C(0₋)/s“+”在上，i_L 从它的“+”端流出、进入 L，所以也是推动电流，取“+”。代入 i_L(0₋) = 1 A、v_C(0₋) = 6 V，右边 = 1 + 6/s。

questions.ask: 极点 p_1 的虚部 ω_d = ?

hints: t < 0：电感短路、电容开路，求 i_L(0₋)、v_C(0₋)。t > 0：电源支路断开，只剩 C、L、R_2 回路。
画运算电路时，两个附加电源都按“维持原状态”的方向放：电感的沿 i_L 推电流；电容在放电，它的“+”端正是 i_L 流出的一端。

en.title: Zero-input response with two initial conditions
statement: V_s = 10 V, R_1 = 4 Ω, C = 40 mF, L = 1 H, R_2 = 6 Ω. Switch S has been closed for a long time and opens at t = 0. The references of i_L (down through L and R_2) and v_C (+ at the top) are as drawn.

For t > 0, C forms one loop with L and R_2, and both storage elements start with stored energy. In the s-domain circuit the inductor is sL in series with a voltage source L·i_L(0−), pushing current along i_L; the capacitor is 1/(sC) in series with a voltage source v_C(0−)/s, + at the top. Find the poles of I_L(s) (the natural frequencies of the circuit for t > 0) and its coefficient K_1 at p_1 = −α + jω_d. Then find i_L and v_C at t = 0.2 s.

questions.ask: The s-domain KVL around the loop C → L → R_2 → C for t > 0 is:
questions.explain: Go round along i_L. The inductor's source L·i_L(0−) pushes current along i_L: a plus sign. The capacitor's source v_C(0−)/s has its + at the top, where i_L leaves the capacitor to enter L, so it pushes too: also a plus sign. With i_L(0−) = 1 A and v_C(0−) = 6 V the right-hand side is 1 + 6/s.
choiceExplain: Wrong sign for the capacitor: i_L leaves the capacitor at its top (+) end; the capacitor discharges and its source drives i_L.
Wrong sign for the inductor: its source keeps the original current i_L(0−) going, in the direction of i_L.
Those are the values of the parallel-form current sources; they cannot go into a series-loop KVL.

questions.explain: i_L(0−) = 10/(4 + 6) = 1 A, v_C(0−) = 6 × 1 = 6 V. I_L(s) = \frac{1 + 6/s}{s + 6 + 25/s} = \frac{s + 6}{s² + 6s + 25}, poles −3 ± j4. These are the natural frequencies (characteristic roots) of the circuit for t > 0.

The capacitor current is −i_L, so V_C(s) = \frac{v_C(0−)}{s} − \frac{I_L(s)}{sC} = \frac{6s + 11}{s² + 6s + 25}. v_C(t) = e^{−3t}(6cos 4t − 1.75 sin 4t) V; at t = 0.2 s: ≈ 0.5488 × (4.180 − 1.255) ≈ 1.605 V.

hints: For t < 0: inductor shorted, capacitor open — find i_L(0−) and v_C(0−). For t > 0 the source branch is open and only the loop C, L, R_2 is left.
Place both initial-condition sources so that they "keep the old state": the inductor's pushes current along i_L; the capacitor is discharging and its + end is where i_L leaves it.
solution: **4. Capacitor voltage.** The capacitor current is −i_L: V_C(s) = \frac{6}{s} − \frac{25}{s}I_L(s) = \frac{6s + 11}{s² + 6s + 25}, v_C = e^{−3t}(6cos 4t − 1.75 sin 4t) V, **v_C(0.2) ≈ 1.605 V**.
